content:
The art director who led the visual design and concept of Lil' Finder Guy, Sofia Coelho, has for once offered a behind-the-scenes look at how this mascot for the MacBook Neo ad campaign came together. Details below.

"Just the height of an Apple"

Apple art director Sofia Coelho today published a post on LinkedIn sharing a fascinating gallery of images, including several behind-the-scenes snapshots that reveal the process of creating Lil' Finder Guy for the MacBook Neo ad campaign.

Coelho's post was presented as a playful "birthday announcement," in which she thanked the team of colleagues who worked together on this campaign that was shortlisted at the Cannes Lions, and described the opportunity to lead the visual design and concept of the character as a "dream-tier design project".

She also shared a photograph containing multiple sketches and research drafts of Lil' Finder Guy's expressions, proportions, and overall look, along with what appears to be a physical prototype created with an airbrush.

Lil' Finder Guy has played a prominent role throughout the MacBook Neo ad campaign, with Apple featuring the character in a livestream event and a series of TikTok videos. The character has also gone viral online, sparking a wave of fan creations including同人 artwork, wallpapers, and 3D-printed models.

The character also appeared as an Easter egg in at least one segment of WWDC 2026, and was made into an enamel pin included in the attendee gift bag.
